subject: Output of analysis stays on screen, even when a different one is done

messages.author: 730aa98b7fdf9625
messages.subject: Output of analysis stays on screen, even when a different one is done
parts:
Hi! I have a problem with Shiny. I'm making a drop down-list of different analyses that can be done, after choosing one from the list and clicking and actionButton. Most of them either produce a table, or print out some text. The problem is, after you get one result, and switch to a different analysis, the output of the previous one stays one the screen! Here is an example of part of server.R for one of the analyses that keep their results on screen:

output$problematic1 <- renderText({   
    input$runButton16
    if (input$runButton16 == 0)
            {return()}       
        else{         
          print("There are 38 pairs of structures with all equal fingerprints and different activity values.")
          }
    })

  output$problematic2 <- renderText({
    input$runButton16
    if (input$runButton16 == 0)
          {return()}
    else{print("There are 24067 pairs of structures which don't have equal fingerprints and have different activity values.")}
  })

Also, the problem happens only when you start doing them back-to-front, i.e. when you do one, then choose another that is before it in the drop-down list. If you do them in order, then I don't have any problems.
